subject.title: fix(channels): normalize phone identities with stray plus signs

question: Should normalizeE164's public Plugin SDK contract drop every non-digit and return empty for digitless phone-like input?
rationale: The implementation looks like the right shared fix, but the helper is exported through Plugin SDK subpaths and green tests do not decide the external compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept canonical phone normalization
options.body: Treat preservation of malformed plus signs as a bug and merge after real behavior proof and normal checks.

options.title: Require an explicit compat note
options.body: Ask for PR-body/docs/test language that names the Plugin SDK behavior change before merge.

options.title: Keep the old SDK behavior
options.body: Reject or narrow the change if maintainers consider malformed plus preservation part of the shipped helper contract.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical phone normalization
recommendation.body: Treat preservation of malformed plus signs as a bug and merge after real behavior proof and normal checks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest recent owner signal for src/utils.ts and the exported helper surface.
